items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: No, I never heard them. I heard them people talk about them.

ctx.x: That's right. I used to like love. He was knife, easy trumpet player. And Thomas too.
He told me he used to go up to Baton Rouge. When he was a young man, he used to ride up on his bicycle and play with Toots Johnson's band. Did you ever hear them?
No, I never heard them. I heard them people talk about them. I see.
